name: How long do tankless water heaters typically last compared to traditional models?

mainEntity.name: How long do tankless water heaters typically last compared to traditional models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tankless water heaters generally have a longer lifespan than traditional tank-style water heaters. A well-maintained tankless unit can last 20 years or more, while conventional tank heaters typically last 10-15 years. This extended lifespan is due to their design, which heats water on demand and reduces constant exposure to high temperatures and sediment buildup common in tanks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tankless water heaters can last 20+ years, while traditional tank heaters typically last 10-15 years.
